excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震。看上去是，由于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人没有进行维护，地下隧道网络的某些深层部分发生了塌方。我们的许多居民都遭受了损失。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]最近又遭受了一波地震。看上去是，由于[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人没有进行维护，地下隧道网络的某些深层部分发生了塌方。我们的许多居民都遭受了损失。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has been racked by another wave of earthquakes recently. It seems that some of the deeper parts of the underground tunnel network has collapsed without the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens to maintain it. Many of our settlements have suffered damage.
